prompt:
• Photography Positioning
2:3 vertical version, ultra-realistic cinematic fashion photography, high-end Editorial style, authentic photographic work, medium format texture, 85mm lens, F2.0, large aperture, shallow depth of field, soft natural light, real skin texture, real silk luster, real fabric drape, slight film grain, low saturation tones, high-end hotel indoor environment.

• High-end hotel suite Setting
Inside a high-end hotel suite, in front of a large full-length mirror, off-white walls, warm gray curtains, floor-to-ceiling windows, natural light entering the room, light-colored carpet, modern furniture (sofa, side table, floor lamp), clean and simple space, quiet, exquisite, and light luxury atmosphere.

• East Asian female around 24 years old
An East Asian female around 24 years old, cool white skin, small and delicate face, light brown large eyes, delicate features.
Long straight black hair, light airy bangs, side hair naturally fits the cheeks. Wearing fine metal-rimmed glasses, cool, gentle, and intellectual temperament.

• Makeup Setting
Natural and clear: Creamy skin texture, gray-pink eye makeup, fine eyeliner, distinct eyelashes, light pink blush, soft matte rose lip makeup. Calm eyes looking at the camera, with a slight sense of thought.

• White long-sleeved lapel shirt with a black silk bow tie and black suspenders Setting
White long-sleeved lapel shirt, paired with a black silk bow tie and black suspenders; the bottom is a black high-waisted mini skirt (with double-breasted gold buttons at the waist), the hem is slightly flared; paired with black pantyhose and black high heels.

• Action Setting
The person stands in front of the full-length mirror, body three-quarters sideways, one leg supporting, the other leg slightly bent forward and touching the ground with the tip of the toe, forming an elegant S-curve. The left hand naturally touches the hair or the side of the ear, while the right hand hangs naturally or is placed lightly on the side of the thigh.
The head turns slightly towards the camera, forming a dual composition through the reflection in the mirror, an elegant, natural, and confident posture.

• Visual Details
The mirror truly reflects the whole body of the character and the indoor environment, maintaining a natural perspective without mirror errors. The composition is simple and high-end, the character is on the right side of the frame, and the mirror occupies the left side, forming a balanced dual composition. The light is soft and natural, slight film grain, low saturation tones, and the overall atmosphere is quiet, high-end, light luxury, and intellectual.

Negative Prompt:
Anime style, illustration, CG feel, fake face, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, excessive beauty filter, wrong body proportions, extra hands, extra legs, mirror distortion, reflection errors, repeating clothing textures, procedural textures, cheap fabrics, cluttered background, text, Logo, watermark.

promptZh:
• 摄影定位
2:3 竖构图，超写实电影感时尚摄影，高端杂志风，真实摄影作品，中画幅质感，85mm 镜头，F2.0，大光圈，浅景深，柔和自然光，真实皮肤纹理，真实丝绸光泽，真实面料垂坠感，轻微胶片颗粒，低饱和色调，高端酒店室内环境。

• 高端酒店套房 设置
位于高端酒店套房内，大型全身镜前，米白色墙面，暖灰色窗帘，落地窗，自然光洒入室内，浅色地毯，现代家具（沙发、边几、落地灯），空间简洁干净，氛围安静、精致且轻奢。

• 24 岁左右东亚女性 设置
24 岁左右东亚女性，冷白皮，小巧精致的脸型，浅棕色大眼睛，五官精致。
黑色长直发，轻盈空气刘海，侧发自然贴合脸颊。佩戴精致金属细框眼镜，气质清冷、温柔且知性。

• 妆容设置
自然清透：奶油肌质感，灰粉色眼影，精致眼线，根根分明的睫毛，淡粉色腮红，柔雾玫瑰色唇妆。眼神平静地注视镜头，略带思考感。

• 白色长袖翻领衬衫，搭配黑色丝绸领结和黑色背带 设置
白色长袖翻领衬衫，搭配黑色丝绸领结和黑色背带；下身着黑色高腰迷你裙（腰间饰有双排金色纽扣），裙摆微张；搭配黑色连裤袜和黑色高跟鞋。

• 动作设置
人物站在全身镜前，身体呈四分之三侧面，单腿支撑，另一条腿微微前屈，脚尖点地，形成优雅的 S 型曲线。左手自然轻抚发丝或耳侧，右手自然下垂或轻放在大腿侧。
头部微微转向镜头，通过镜面反射形成双重构图，姿态优雅、自然且自信。

• 视觉细节
镜面真实反映人物全身及室内环境，保持自然视角，无镜面错误。构图简洁高端，人物位于画面右侧，镜面占据左侧，形成平衡的双重构图。光线柔和自然，带有轻微胶片颗粒，低饱和色调，整体氛围安静、高端、轻奢且知性。

负面提示词 (Negative Prompt)：
动漫风格，插画，CG 感，假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，过度美颜，身体比例错误，多余的手，多余的腿，镜面畸变，反射错误，重复的服装纹理，程序化纹理，廉价面料，杂乱背景，文字，Logo，水印。
